verdict.rationale: Neon documents a public Management API at console.neon.tech/api/v2 with Bearer API-key auth. Keys come in three scopes: personal, organization and project. Probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec and an LLM-addressed endpoint index with per-endpoint pages. Neon also positions the API for fully programmatic project creation, configuration and cleanup at very large scale. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of authenticated API calls actually driving the product (probes only confirm the docs and spec are live).
